mechanism: Primidone induces CYP450 enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2C9) which may increase minocycline metabolism, potentially reducing antibiotic efficacy; minocycline may also increase photosensitivity risk when combined with enzyme-inducing anticonvulsants.
action: Monitor clinical response to minocycline therapy; consider alternative antibiotic if efficacy concerns arise; counsel on enhanced photosensitivity precautions.
